detail:
- **Documented**: 7 of 7 modules carry an author's summary

19 requirements: 5 checked and 14 refuted.
label: scripts
quotes: This module is the command-line entry point for rendering a talk piece, providing usage help, contract printing, tag listing, and version output.

Core defines the rendering engine that parses talk content and walks/encodes components into the HTML and props used to render a piece, including the error-raising checks that validate talk structure.
Entry module that renders a talk piece by coordinating core and spelling functionality, requiring a pieces folder to be present.
Parse is the module that reads and decodes raw piece content into structured node data consumed across the markup, talk-preparation, node-resolution, and spelling-check pipelines.
Spelling is a module that checks the spelling of rendered talk content as part of the piece validation pipeline.
The Panel module implements a runtime debugging overlay used during rendered-piece checks, invoked from the runtime boot process and relying on document.body being available.

Documents runtime.mjs as the core runtime module that renders components, hydrates islands, and coordinates with core and panel at run time, including a failure path where rejectPath can throw an Error.
